rows.note: Use 聯絡 as the all-purpose choice when establishing or maintaining contact between people or organizations.

example.english: We will liaise with the other company to follow up on the collaboration.
example.traditional: 我哋會聯絡對方公司，跟進合作事宜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 lyun4 lok3 deoi3 fong1 gung1 si1 gan1 zeon3 hap6 zok3 si6 ji4

rows.note: Use 溝通 when the emphasis is on exchanging information and discussing matters to reach understanding.

example.english: Before the meeting, everyone should liaise with one another to clarify the arrangements.
example.traditional: 開會之前，大家要先溝通清楚安排。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui2 zi1 cin4 daai6 gaa1 jiu3 sin1 kau1 tung1 cing1 co2 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use 協調 when parties' differences or positions need reconciling, or when their actions need aligning toward a common solution.

example.english: The manager needs to liaise between the two departments to reconcile their different views.
example.traditional: 呢兩個部門意見唔同，要由經理出面協調。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 ji3 gin3 m4 tung4 jiu3 jau4 ging1 lei5 ceot1 min2 hip3 tiu4
